body:
Welcome to Starry SATB Choir ✨

Every Voice Matters. Together, We Shine Brighter.

Starry SATB Choir is a vibrant, welcoming, and diverse mixed-voice choir based in Winnipeg. Just as every star is unique, every voice matters — and together, we shine brighter.

We explore choral music from around the world, with a special love for Chinese and Asian musical traditions. Through music, we celebrate different cultures, build friendships, and bring people together.

But Starry is more than just singing! From exciting performances and community events to cultural celebrations, volunteer activities, and unforgettable moments together, we’re always finding new ways to share our love of music and make meaningful connections.

In 2026, we proudly received a Gold Award at the Winnipeg Music Festival Choral Competition, marking another exciting milestone in our musical journey.

Whether you’re an experienced singer, a music lover, or simply curious about what we do, you’re always welcome to be part of our Starry community.

Let every voice shine. Together, we sing like stars. 🌟
